jobs.description:
As a project coordinator you ensure that vehicles and mobility solutions meet all required regulations before entering the market. You operate in the homologation team; the heart of engineering, compliance, and coordination.
 

Your responsibilities include:
 

• Collecting, verifying, and managing technical documentation for approval.
 

• Following up on homologation planning and testing activities with internal stakeholders.
 

• Supporting vehicle testing with official authorities and ensuring correct execution.
 

• Managing certification processes, including Certificates of Conformity (CoC).
 

• Monitoring and interpreting EU and international regulations (UNECE, emissions, safety).
 

• Acting as a key point of contact for internal teams and European stakeholders.
 

• Handling administrative follow-up (documentation, SharePoint, reporting, guidelines).
 

• Improving processes around compliance tracking and data management.
 

 

You are structured, analytical, and able to create clarity in a complex and fast-moving environment.
 

• You have a Bachelor or Master in a technical field (Automotive, Mechanical, Industrial Engineering or similar).
 

• You are experienced in homologation, automotive compliance, testing, vehicle development, or technical documentation.
 

• You have a strong analytical mindset with advanced MS Office and SharePoint skills.
 

• You can organize and prioritize in an ad hoc, high-pressure environment.
 

• You take ownership and work autonomously towards deadlines, with accuracy and attention to detail.
 

• You have excellent communication skills in English, with good command of Dutch or French.
 

• You have perseverance and resilience in a demanding international context.

For a meat company in Zele, we are looking for a production worker who will be working in various departments.
 

Your tasks:

- placing meat on the production line;

- cutting meat (cutting skills are not required);

- packing;

- loading and unloading trucks.

- You're looking for a physical, varied job in a production environment. 

- You communicate smoothly, with knowledge of Dutch, English, French, and/or Romanian. 

- You like working independently, but you're also a team player. 

- You take responsibility and are reliable. 

- You can work under pressure and set the right priorities. 

- You're flexible with working hours: start between 3:30 AM and 6:30 AM, and you work until everything is done. 

- You're fine working in a cold environment and standing up.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

Our client is an established family-owned company with more than 30 years of experience in the food industry, specialized in the production and processing of fresh potato products.

The company combines modern production technology with a strong focus on quality, hygiene and food safety. You will join a professional and dynamic production environment where teamwork, reliability and quality are key.

We are currently looking for an experienced and motivated Line Supervisor to join a production environment in the food industry. You will be responsible for the smooth operation of the production line and will help ensure that production runs safely, efficiently, and according to quality standards.

Your responsibilities:

 
• 
Start up and monitor the production line

 
• 
Coordinate the daily activities on the production line

 
• 
Operate and supervise production equipment

 
• 
Identify and resolve minor operational issues

 
• 
Ensure quality, safety, and hygiene standards are followed

 
• 
Work closely with operators and other production colleagues

 
• 
Operate a forklift when required

 
• 
Previous experience as a production operator; experience as a Line Supervisor / Line Leader is a strong advantage

 
• 
Forklift experience

 
• 
Willingness to work in the food production industry

 
• 
Strong sense of responsibility and ability to take the lead on the production line

 
• 
Very good command of English

 
• 
Willingness to work in a 2-shift system

Are you ready to take charge on a production line? Do you enjoy working with your hands and being part of a close team?

Join one of the world’s leading mushroom companies, right here in your region. As an operator, you’ll help keep the line running — adjusting machines, switching molds, and sealing mushroom boxes. You work 5 days a week, with either the full weekend off or a weekday off if you work Saturday. Your shift starts at 6am or 8am depending on the season.

What you can expect:

• A key role in a solid, reliable team

• Hands-on work with real responsibility

• A company that’s big in the global mushroom market

• Long-term opportunity for people who want to grow

Sound like your kind of job? Let’s talk!

• You’re someone who keeps an eye on the bigger picture — you think ahead, spot small issues before they become big ones, and help the line run like clockwork.

• Experience in a production environment is a plus, but if you’re motivated and hands-on, we’ll get you up to speed.

• The working language in the company is English, so Dutch is not required.

One of your main tasks will be to investigate complaints, deviations, out-of-specifications (OOS) and non-conformities, draft a report on these and propose corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

You will take on a part of the batch release activities of the medicines and other medical products produced on site. Additionally, you will monitor compliance to the internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and GMP (flows and zoning included) in production and the laboratory.

More specific: 

• Investigation and drafting of report for deviations; OOS; complaints and non-conformitiesMonitor compliance on internal standard operating procedures (SOP’s) and GMP in production and laboratory area
• Final batch release - including review of batch records (1-2h per day)
• GMP/GDP/Pharmacovigilance training of QC and production operators; warehouse workers and drivers.
• Writing of the yearly PQR (Product Quality Review)
• Review of QC and GMP procedures
• Involvement in GMP validation and qualification activities (equipment and processes in production and laboratory area) and other GMP projects
• Management of CAPA’s related to GMP activities
• Management of change controls related to GMP activities
• Support during (preparation of) audits on site
• Perform internal audits at other sites and suppliers

• You have a master degree in Industrial pharmacy
• You have at least 1 or 3 year experience in a GMP environment.
• You are a teamplayer, dynamic and have very good communication skills.
• Your mothertongue is Dutch and are fluent in English and French

As a 
Quotation Engineer, you will support the commercial process from A to Z. You will work closely with the Sales team and have direct contact with customers to fully understand their technical requirements and expectations. Your ability to analyze information, interpret specifications, and propose suitable solutions will be key to delivering accurate and competitive quotations.
 

Thanks to your analytical mindset and customer-focused approach, you ensure that every proposal is technically sound, commercially attractive, and perfectly aligned with customer expectations. At the same time, you contribute to efficient processes and foster strong collaboration between all stakeholders involved. 
 

Your Responsibilities:
 

As a Quotation Engineer, you will:

• Work closely with the Sales team to prepare quotations, pricing proposals, and technical solutions for our customers. 

• Maintain direct contact with customers to fully understand their needs, technical requirements, and expectations. 

• Analyze customer specifications and translate them into the standard solutions and capabilities offered by RapidFit Plus. 

• Accurately interpret customer expectations and align them with internal technical and operational requirements. 

• Collect and provide all necessary information to ensure accurate cost calculations and the preparation of competitive quotations. 

• Prepare clear, accurate, and customer-focused quotations that meet customer needs and requirements. 

• Ensure proposed solutions are presented transparently and that the scope of services is clearly defined and documented. 

• Collaborate closely with Project Engineers to guarantee a smooth transfer of information during project kick-off and implementation meetings. 

• Identify opportunities for continuous improvement of sales processes, quotation workflows, and customer collaboration. 

• Ensure timely and accurate processing and maintenance of customer, project, and quotation data within the ERP system. 
 

 

• You hold a degree in Industrial Engineering. 

• Experience in a technical environment such as automotive, machine building, tooling, mold manufacturing, plastics processing, or production engineering is a strong asset.

• You possess strong analytical skills and can easily interpret technical specifications. 

• You communicate effectively with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders. 

• You work in a structured, accurate, and solution-oriented manner. 

• You are proficient in Microsoft Excel. 

• You have an affinity for digitalization and technological innovation. 

• You have an excellent command of English. 

• An interest in AI applications and their potential to improve business processes is considered a valuable asset.

Als internationaal familiebedrijf ontwikkelen en co-creëren we - op een vernieuwende, ondernemende en duurzame manier - vloer- en materiaaloplossingen om de woon- en werkkwaliteit van elke generatie te verbeteren. 

B.I.G. heeft zijn hoofdzetel in België, stelt wereldwijd meer dan 4.700 mensen tewerk in 19 landen in Eurazië, Amerika en Oceanië, en bedient klanten in 150 landen. In 2023 boekte B.I.G. een omzet van € 2 miljard. 

Bij B.I.G. werken we doelgericht aan een duurzame toekomst. De combinatie van onze ondernemingszin en ambitie zorgt ervoor dat wij blijven groeien, samen met onze medewerkers, klanten, leveranciers, aandeelhouders en de samenleving om ons heen.

About the role

As Group Marketing Director, you lead Beaulieu's central marketing team. Guided by strategic insights, you act as the group's marketing center of excellence, shaping marketing strategy and supporting divisions in building and executing their growth plans.
In parallel, you oversee the shared marketing services within Beaulieu, including events, graphic design, and digital marketing, ensuring every division benefits from consistent, high-quality execution.
You lead a team of marketing professionals, combining strategic vision with hands-on leadership to translate ideas into impact and ensure that both strategy and execution meet the highest standards.

 

Key responsibilities
 
• You collaborate closely with divisional management and marketeers to develop and execute marketing strategies that drive growth. Acting as a strategic partner, you help identify where marketing can create the greatest impact, align priorities, and turn direction into measurable action. 
• You act as a trusted marketing partner to senior management and division leaders, translating their commercial priorities into marketing action, and representing marketing's voice in group-level decision-making. 
• You lead, coach, and develop the central marketing team, bringing together expertise in CRM, events, graphic design, and digital marketing. You set clear priorities and ensures the team operates as both a center of excellence and a trusted shared services partner to the divisions. 
• Together with divisional marketing teams, you lead the execution of creative, high-impact campaigns across the group, translating strategic priorities into initiatives that deliver results. 
• In close collaboration with divisional marketing and sales teams, you ensure marketing acts as a true commercial growth partner. You provide the insights, tools, and content that help sales engage customers more effectively, while aligning messaging, positioning, and value propositions. 
• You oversee relationships with external partners, including agencies, freelancers, and technology providers, ensuring high-quality delivery and maximizing the value of external expertise across the group. 
• You own the group marketing budget, allocating resources across shared services and divisional needs, and ensuring spend translates into measurable ROI. 
• You lead the group's CRM center of excellence, developing the capabilities, standards, and support needed to maximize the value of Salesforce CRM across the organization. By driving adoption, enabling best practices, and fostering cross-functional collaboration, you ensure CRM is leveraged consistently and effectively across departments. 
• You work closely with the Corporate Communications Director to ensure strong alignment between marketing and communication efforts across the organization. By coordinating branding initiatives, organizational events, and strategic communications, you drive consistency, leverage synergies, and avoid duplication of efforts across the group.  
 

What you bring
 
• At least 10 years of experience in a marketing leadership role. Experience within an international, multi-business organization with a central/decentralized operating model is a plus. 
• Strategic marketing: you know how to segment markets, define positioning, and translate market insights into a marketing strategy and plan aligned with business needs. Proven experience in developing and executing integrated marketing strategies with measurable business impact. 
• Digital marketing: SEO/GEO, paid advertising, email marketing and automation, and digital experience and platforms. Solid understanding of digital marketing, campaign management, and performance analytics. 
• Lead generation: You know how to design and drive campaigns that generate qualified leads and support the sales funnel. 
• You are a trusted partner who operates seamlessly across organizational boundaries. Bridging group and divisional interests, strategic priorities and business execution, and marketing and executive leadership, you create alignment, build commitment, and help the organization move forward with a shared sense of purpose. 
• Excellent communication and presentation skills (in English). 
• Proactive, structured, and results-oriented with a hands-on mentality.

Job description 
 As a CE truck driver, you will be responsible for delivering various types of materials throughout Belgium. Whether it’s express deliveries, pallet transport, or construction-related materials, you’ll encounter a wide variety of jobs. Every day is different, while still offering a familiar routine. What does your day look like? 
    
• You start your day between 5:00 and 8:00 a.m. at our site in Bornem with a cup of coffee and a vehicle check.
    
• You will deliver various goods throughout Belgium. Occasionally, you may cross the border, but you will always return home at the end of the day.
    
• The number of daily stops depends on the schedule. Sometimes you may have just 1 stop, while on other days you could have up to 10.
 What are we looking for? 
    
• You have a CE driving licence and the required certificates.
    
• You have a valid ADR certificate.
    
• You are flexible, reliable, and customer-friendly.
    
• You are physically fit.
    
• You have experience as a CE truck driver.
    
• You have good knowledge of the road network.
    
• You have a good command of Dutch or English due to safety requirements.
 What can you expect from us? 
    
• A competitive salary.
    
• A great working atmosphere and the opportunity to drive modern, high-quality equipment.

Can you tick all the boxes above? Apply today and join our team!

 Requirements 

    
• You have a Category C driving licence and the required certificates.
    
• You have a valid ADR certificate.
    
• You are flexible, reliable, and customer-friendly.
    
• You are physically fit.
    
• You have experience as a Category C truck driver.
    
• You have good knowledge of the road network.
    
• You have a good command of Dutch or English due to safety requirements.

can you recognise yourself in this?

We are looking for a highly motivated Logistics Operator  for a leading company in the industrial sector. You will be responsible for ensuring smooth internal transport and efficient warehouse management.

 

Your mission;

You will play a crucial role in the efficient and safe processing of goods within the industrial site.

• You select and prepare the correct handling equipment, according to the characteristics of the products and the movement conditions.
• You welcome drivers to the industrial site, collecting and identifying documents from the administrative department.
• You are responsible for unloading or loading trucks.
• You move goods to the storage area and store the received raw materials in their appropriate locations.
• You check the condition of loads, identify anomalies, and pass them on to the relevant department.
• You carry out handling operations using handling equipment (such as forklifts, bulldozers, etc.).
• You ensure the order and cleanliness of the activity.
 

Your profile and skills;

• You are a true team player.
• You are eager to learn and always open to acquiring new skills.
• You are flexible and able to adapt easily to changing circumstances.
• You work in an organized manner and maintain oversight, even in a dynamic environment.
• Working safely comes naturally to you, and you strictly follow procedures.
• Experience with a forklift is a plus, although this is not a strict requirement.
• You have a good command of French and English , allowing you to communicate smoothly in the workplace.
